# Desert Wind

Desert Wind is the mauve Pegasus stallion you can spot enjoying Las Pegasus and, rather unexpectedly, sitting on Equestria's education council. He is a background character in the G4 television continuity of *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*.

[![Hasbro / DHX Media — EEA character turnaround; Desert Wind is in the top row](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2025/12/15/3669115/medium.png)](https://www.twibooru.org/3669115?q=official)

- **Appearance:** Dusty pink-purple coat, swept-up dark violet mane and tail, blue-violet eyes, and a cutie mark depicting two hay piles and wispy clouds. As an education official, he wears a burgundy robe with gold trim.
- **Name:** Desert Wind is a fandom identification, not a verified spoken or credited television name. The exact origin of the fan name is unconfirmed. Gameloft calls him **Las Pegasus Visitor**, a playable character introduced in update 9.2 ([game character reference](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Las_Pegasus_Visitor)).
- **Speaking status:** Apparently non-speaking; no individual dialogue or voice actor has been verified.
- **Appearances:** Debuts in *Viva Las Pegasus* (S6E20). The [Pegasus character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Pegasus_ponies) also records *School Daze – Part 1*, *Grannies Gone Wild*, *Friendship University*, *Between Dark and Dawn*, and *Baby Flurry Heart's Heartfelt Scrapbook* episode 8.

## Important moments

No individual heroic act or character-defining dialogue is documented; these are his two most useful identification scenes.

- **Resort debut — [Viva Las Pegasus (S6E20)](https://www.tvmaze.com/episodes/831157/my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic-6x20-viva-las-pegasus).** His first appearance places him among the guests at Gladmane's resort. Video timestamp unavailable.
- **School accreditation — [School Daze – Part 1 (S8E1)](https://transcripts.foreverdreaming.org/viewtopic.php?t=72278).** He is among the Equestria Education Association board members when the council provisionally approves Twilight's School of Friendship; no individual vote or line is attributed to him. Video timestamp unavailable.

[![Hasbro / DHX Media — Grannies Gone Wild (S8E5), Desert Wind at the far left of DJ Pon-3's club](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2024/9/7/3328999/medium.png)](https://www.twibooru.org/3328999)
